{{Quote|Welcome to Coruscant. How may I help you?|Tourist Director to Captain Panaka|<ref name="TPMVG">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref>}}
The '''Tourist Director''' was a job in the [[Tourist Center]] company on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The Tourist Director was responsible for directing customers to their destinations. They also assisted customers with their complaints and had access to company [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]], which customers were not authorized to use.<ref name="TPMVG" />
